scope: Substantive src changes plus new src/ui/SourceInspector.tsx

reuse.finding: Next-unresolved navigation recomputes run.rows.filter(r => r.issues.length), identical to exceptionRows maintained by setRun.
reuse.suggestion: Use exceptionRows for ordered find and fallback.

quality.finding: sourcePage has five positional parameters, requiring undefined placeholders for navigation modes.
quality.suggestion: Use a shared named source-query object and spread it into the worker request; update SourceInspector and Workspace callers.

efficiency.finding: view rebuilds a full result-row map on each pagination request.
efficiency.suggestion: Build resultById in setRun alongside exceptionRows, then reuse it in view.

efficiency.finding: Each visible cell scans every pending correction on each keystroke.
efficiency.suggestion: Index unique row/column coordinates once per render and retrieve each pending edit.

efficiency.finding: Every evaluated field filters/maps fieldIssues even when no required-blank issue is emitted.
efficiency.suggestion: Compute upstream cause keys only within the required-blank branch.

application.verification: Typecheck/lint passed after all five changes; 297 unit tests passed in a subsequent isolated run; full Chromium regression and review-fix checks recorded in ../verification.md.
